newsitem.title: JAPAN: Banyu Pharmaceutical up on possible drug sales.
newsitem.headline: Banyu Pharmaceutical up on possible drug sales.

text.p: Banyu Pharmaceutical Co Ltd shares were given a boost on Friday by news that the firm hopes to start selling the AIDS drug Indinavir in Japan in early April, brokers said.
As of 0437 GMT, the shares were up 30 yen at 1,720.

A spokesman for the company said on Friday that a government advisory panel on drug approval gave its backing for the AIDS drug on Thursday. The company is now waiting for the Ministry of Health and Welfare's formal approval, he said.
